extDescription.message: Blurs text, images and video that mention or show the people you choose, on every site, before you see them.

siteUnavailable.message: Perde cannot run on this page.

addHint.message: A director, an actor, any person.

aliasesHint.message: Surname, nickname, film titles. Separate with commas.

modeBlurHint.message: Shapes stay visible, text is unreadable.

modeHideHint.message: The content disappears from the page and cannot be revealed.

revealHint.message: Click a covered block to see it. When off, covered content stays covered.

blockPageLabel.message: Cover the whole page when its title matches

blockPageHint.message: For pages that are entirely about a blocked name, such as a profile or a search.

pageBlockedText.message: Its title matches a name on your block list.

facesIntro.message: Covers photos and video that show a blocked person even when no text mentions them. The model runs on this computer; no image leaves the browser.

faceMatchHint.message: Works for names that have at least one reference face.

facePreBlurLabel.message: Keep images blurred until they are checked

facePreBlurHint.message: Images appear a moment later, but a blocked face is never shown first. When off, a matching image stays visible until its check finishes.

faceVideoHint.message: Looks at a frame about twice a second and covers the video while a blocked face is on screen. The first moment of a scene can be visible, and protected (DRM) video cannot be read.

autoLookupLabel.message: Look new names up on Wikipedia

autoLookupHint.message: Finds other spellings and reference faces from public photos, so you never have to look for them. Only the name is sent, to Wikipedia, Wikidata and Wikimedia Commons.

strictnessLegend.message: How similar a face must be

strictStrictHint.message: Fewer wrong matches, may miss some photos.

strictLooseHint.message: Catches more photos, may cover look-alikes.

lookupNone.message: Not found on Wikipedia as a person

enrollError.message: The photos could not be read

backupIntro.message: Save your block list, reference faces included, to a file. The macOS app reads the same file.

importError.message: This file is not a Perde backup

addHintLookup.message: The name is also looked up on Wikipedia to find other spellings and reference faces. You can turn this off in the settings.

veilHint.message: Names stay blurred here until you point at them.

scopeNameHint.message: The name itself is covered; the text around it stays readable.

scopeBlockHint.message: The line or paragraph that contains the name is covered.

scopeCardHint.message: The search result, post or video tile around the name is covered, thumbnail included.
